title: The Rarest Blood Type Is Just 1% Of Americans
hook: Just 1% of Americans have the rarest blood type.
closing: Rarity makes matching harder, so knowing and donating your type can save time.
question: Do you know your blood type?

segments.say: AB negative belongs to just 1% of Americans, making compatible donors exceptionally scarce.
Only 15% are Rh negative, shrinking the matching pool before doctors even consider letter type.
O positive reaches 53% among Latin American donors, showing donor background changes the available mix.
